title: Dust Collector · IDEX Fume Extraction
equipment: Pulse-jet bag filter (2 compartments), ID fan and 18 m self-supported chimney on the IDEX fume take-off
summary: Operator training simulator built from the general-arrangement drawing: the line from IDEX to the chimney in 3D, a bag-filter control panel, pulse-jet cleaning, fan flow control, dilution protection, a guided tour and fault injection. English and Arabic.
